_doc: Per-bone joint limits for validate_anim.py (degrees). Measured on the canonical local rotation relative to the A-pose rest: 'swing' = angle between the rest bone direction and the posed one in the parent's frame, 'twist' = rotation about the bone axis, 'hinge' = signed flex of the segment against its parent (knee: shin behind the thigh is +, elbow: forearm in front of the upper arm is +; below min = hyperextension). Limits are 'a human cannot do this' bounds, not style bounds: a WARN over the limit is worth a look, FAIL is over by more than thresholds.joint_limit_over_deg[1]. Bones missing here are not checked (root, hips, eyes, attach_*).
